gloss: to wipe away; to erase completely

definitions.gloss: to wipe away; to erase completely; to dispel
definitions.explanation: To completely remove or eliminate something by wiping. Used both literally (wiping something off a surface) and figuratively (dispelling doubts, fears, or negative feelings).

examples.japanese: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{消|け}した。
⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{消|け}すこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。

⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{消|け}すよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んだ→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: As if to wipe away the memory of past failures, I threw myself fully into the new challenge.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧ (to wipe) and ⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ (to erase/extinguish). The figurative use — dispelling doubts, anxiety, or bad impressions — is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{消|け}す: to dispel anxiety
- ⟦{疑念|ぎねん}→疑念：17971_ginen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{消|け}す: to erase doubts
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{消|け}す: to wipe away tears
- ⟦{汚名|おめい}→汚名：13265_omei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ふ}き{消|け}す: to clear one's name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {拭|ぬぐ}い{去|さ}る: to wipe away — similar meaning, slightly more literary
- ⟦{払拭|ふっしょく}→払拭：09461_fusshoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispel; to wipe clean — formal Sino-Japanese equivalent
- {消|け}し{去|さ}る: to erase; to obliterate — emphasizes complete removal

COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb (す row). Transitive. Conjugates: {拭|ふ}き{消|け}さない, {拭|ふ}き{消|け}して, {拭|ふ}き{消|け}します.
